headlines.title: New twist in critical Michigan Senate race
headlines.description: Rep. Haley Stevens has pulled her endorsement of her party’s nominee Abdul El-Sayed, and has announced she is now backing his Republican opponent Mike Rogers in the Michigan Senate race. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz reports.

headlines.title: Judge dismisses Trump lawsuit in Alaska Senate race
headlines.description: A federal judge on Sunday rejected the Trump administration’s lawsuit that demanded officials not certify election results in the Senate race there, if the incumbent senator loses. NBC News’ Steve Patterson reports.

headlines.title: Democrats in key battlegrounds throw Joe Biden under the bus on the border
headlines.description: Democratic candidates in 2026 battleground races are criticizing Joe Biden’s handling of border security, seeking to neutralize a political vulnerability.

headlines.title: Steve Kornacki breaks down final NBC News poll before midterm elections
headlines.description: Democrats have a sizable advantage in the battle for control of Congress days ahead of the midterm elections, a new national NBC News poll finds, with voters clamoring for change and voicing all-time high disapproval of President Trump. NBC News’ Steve Kornacki breaks down the numbers.

headlines.title: Sen. Tim Scott dodges on whether he would accept the results of the Alaska Senate race
headlines.description: Sen. Tim Scott, R-S.C., declined to say whether he would accept the results of the Alaska Senate race if Democrat Mary Peltola wins the battleground seat

headlines.title: Go Behind the Scenes of NBC News’ Decision Desk
headlines.description: TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie goes behind-the-scenes with the NBC News team tasked with calling election night’s pivotal races from coast-to-coast.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Rep. Haley Stevens, D-Mich., endorsed Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers on Sunday, a major shake-up in the final stages of a top battleground race that could determine which party controls the Senate.

headlines.title: Fiery plane crash in Florida
headlines.description: A private jet crashed into a South Florida neighborhood killing all nine people on board according to transportation secretary Sean Duffy. The plane was flying from Austin, Texas to the Bahamas when it crashed. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch has the latest.

headlines.title: Elementary school in middle of 11 data centers
headlines.description: NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk investigates how 11 data centers ended up being within half a mile of an elementary school in northern Virginia and what the backup generators with those centers could be doing to the air quality.

headlines.title: Sen. Chris Murphy hospitalized after stroke
headlines.description: A spokesperson for the Connecticut Democrat said he experienced numbness in his arm.

headlines.title: Kimi Antonelli becomes youngest Formula 1 champion ever at 20 years old
headlines.description: The Italian prodigy clinched the 2026 world championship in Mexico, vanquishing his rivals from contention with four races still on the calendar.

headlines.title: Martha Stewart responds to backlash over ‘hungry’ homeless Halloween costume
headlines.description: Stewart, who dressed as a homeless person for Halloween while promoting her candles in the same Instagram post, said she had “intended to bring more awareness to the very serious subject of homelessness.”
